description: This file defines the validation rule class `TimesheetDateRule` used within the OrangeHRM time tracking plugin. It validates whether a given date is not in the future and whether a timesheet already exists for that date for a specific employee.

classes.name: TimesheetDateRule
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks if a given date is not in the future and if a timesheet already exists for a specific employee on that date.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the rule with the employee number.

methods.description: Performs validation to ensure the input date is not in the future and no existing timesheet exists for that date for the employee.
